name: Crossroads Fine Woodworking
old_description: Discover tools and materials that elevate your woodworking projects.
about:
Crossroads Fine Woodworking is preparing to open its doors in Marion, Indiana. The company has announced a grand opening and is promoting reduced membership fees for a limited time, though no founding year, ownership structure, or founder names have been disclosed.

The business operates as a retail outlet and community workshop, selling woodworking supplies, lumber, and providing shared workshop access through membership programs. Its inventory spans sanding discs and abrasives, orbital sanders, dust extraction systems, pocket-hole jigs, clamp systems, measuring tools, carving tool sets, and basswood blanks. Brands carried include Kreg and Festool, among others featured in a curated collection.

The shop serves woodworkers across skill levels, from hobbyists to professionals, though specific customer segments are not detailed. The combination of material supply and shared workspace positions it as a local resource for project-based fabrication and tool access.

The company has not publicly stated a founding mission or explicit differentiator beyond its dual retail-and-workshop model, which aims to provide both the tools and the space to use them.
